Lipstick: not permitted.
21 CFR 74.2304(b) states: "FD&C Red No. 4 may be safely used for coloring externally applied cosmetics in amounts consistent with good manufacturing practice." [2].
21 CFR 70.3(v) states: "The terms externally applied drugs and externally applied cosmetics mean drugs or cosmetics applied only to external parts of the body and not to the lips or any body surface covered by mucous membrane." [6].
Body lotion: permitted.
Use limit: no percentage is stated; the amount is consistent with good manufacturing practice [2].
21 CFR 74.2304(a) states: "The color additive FD&C Red No. 4 shall conform in identity and specifications to the requirements of § 74.1304(a)(1) and (b)." [1].
21 CFR 74.2304(c) states: "The label of the color additive shall conform to the requirements of § 70.25 of this chapter." [3].
21 CFR 74.2304(d) states: "All batches of FD&C Red No. 4 shall be certified in accordance with regulations in part 80 of this chapter." [4].
21 CFR 82.304 states: "The color additive FD&C Red No. 4 shall conform in identity and specifications to the requirements of § 74.1304(a)(1) and (b) of this chapter. FD&C Red No. 4 is restricted to use in externally applied drugs and cosmetics." [5].
21 CFR 82.50 states: "A batch of a straight color listed in this subpart may be certified, in accordance with the provisions of the regulations in this part, for use in food, drugs, and cosmetics, if such batch conforms to the requirements of § 82.5 and to the specifications in this subpart set forth for such color." [7].
